name: preview-pages
title: Preview pages
description: Ready pages that are still provisional (a draft, or written from early sources): a status flag beside the title on the home page and a banner under the page title. A page opts in with "statusLabel" in site.json; its status stays "ready".

banner.default: {label}. This page is provisional and will be revised.
banner.description: Banner under the page title (HTML). Fields: {label} (the page's statusLabel) and the page fields {id} {badge} {title} {noun} …. A page can set "statusNote" to replace it; "" turns the banner off.

flag.description: Show the statusLabel beside the title in the home catalog (search finds it too).
